subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which compatibility-safe Feishu bind grammar should this PR implement before further review?
rationale: The PR changes a documented CLI input that writes persisted route bindings, and related candidate PRs propose different account-vs-peer grammar shapes.

options.title: Preserve account grammar and add explicit peer routing
options.body: Keep existing `<channel>:<account>` and channel-only resolver behavior, then add a documented explicit peer form or plugin-owned resolver for Feishu conversation IDs.

options.title: Accept Feishu reinterpretation with migration proof
options.body: Allow `feishu:<id>` to mean a group peer only if maintainers intentionally accept the breaking grammar change and require docs plus upgrade guidance.

options.title: Pause this branch for a sibling candidate
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer the grammar choice until the competing Feishu bind PRs are compared against the same compatibility and proof bar.

recommendation.title: Preserve account grammar and add explicit peer routing
recommendation.body: Keep existing `<channel>:<account>` and channel-only resolver behavior, then add a documented explicit peer form or plugin-owned resolver for Feishu conversation IDs.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent refactor history make this the best available routing candidate for the bind/parser decision.
